description: This file defines a function RSFilter that processes a database recordset by applying a callback function to each row, optionally converting the recordset if it's not already in an array format. It is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer library and includes logic to filter and modify recordset rows.

methods.name: RSFilter
methods.description: Filters a recordset by applying a callback function to each row, handling different recordset types and resetting the recordset's current position.
